caption: Supplementary Fig. 32 | Environmental information and SCS humidity after historical-threshold departure. a, Held-out interval-log-likelihood gains from adding dynamics, moisture, thermodynamics or all environmental variables to the common baseline on 1,281 main-sample cyclones. Error bars are paired 95% intervals; gains from separate additions are not additive contributions. b, Mean 700-hPa specific humidity in the 300–800 km annulus at 0, 6, 12, 18 and 24 hours after departure, with the existing pointwise 95% intervals. Complete five-time diagnostic support comprises 15 returning, 30 complete-nonreturning and 42 unknown-outcome cyclones. The full SCS departure subset contains 94 cyclones, including 49 with unknown outcomes; the seven without complete five-time humidity support are not reassigned as nonreturns.
